tasks.title: Initialize project foundation and dependencies
tasks.description: Set up Vite 7 + React 18 + TypeScript 5 project with pnpm, configure Tailwind CSS v4, and install core dependencies
tasks.details:
1. Run `pnpm create vite@latest . --template react-swc-ts` to initialize Vite 7 with React 18 and SWC 2. Install dependencies: `pnpm add zustand@5 @tanstack/react-router@1 react-colorful@5 @mediapipe/selfie_segmentation@0.1` 3. Install Tailwind CSS v4: `pnpm add -D tailwindcss@next @tailwindcss/vite@next` 4. Configure `vite.config.ts` with `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin 5. Create `src/index.css` with `@import "tailwindcss"` 6. Configure `tsconfig.json` with strict mode, ES2020 target, ESNext modules, path aliases 7. Update `index.html` with single `
` 8. Verify build works: `pnpm run dev`
tasks.testStrategy: Run `pnpm run dev` and verify dev server starts without errors. Run `pnpm run build` and verify TypeScript compilation succeeds.

tasks.title: Add cross-browser testing for rendering modes
tasks.description: Verify all three rendering modes work correctly in Chrome, Firefox, Safari (desktop + mobile)
tasks.details:
Test matrix:

**Desktop:**
- Chrome (latest): monochrome, color, emoji modes
- Firefox (latest): monochrome, color, emoji modes
- Safari (latest): monochrome, color, emoji modes

**Mobile:**
- Chrome Android: all modes, responsive layout
- Safari iOS: all modes, responsive layout

**Specific checks:**
- Emoji rendering consistency: verify emojis from EMOJI_COLOR_PALETTE appear similar across platforms
- Color mode HTML rendering: verify inline styles work in all browsers
- Canvas APIs: verify getUserMedia, Canvas 2D, MediaPipe WASM load correctly
- Responsive layout: verify ASCII width auto-scales, portrait mode detection works

**Known issues:**
- Safari < 16.4: no OffscreenCanvas support (not blocking for Phase 3)
- Firefox: emoji rendering may differ from Chromium/WebKit

Document any browser-specific quirks in `docs/infra/decisions.md`.
tasks.testStrategy: Open app in each browser. Start webcam and cycle through all three modes. Verify output appears correctly. Take screenshots in each mode and verify export works. Test on mobile devices for responsive layout.

tasks.title: Decouple pipeline into independent stages
tasks.description: Split render loop into video capture, segmentation, and ASCII conversion stages with independent queues
tasks.details:
Refactor render loop into three independent async stages:

**Stage 1: Video Capture**
- Runs at camera FPS (30fps)
- Draws video frame to canvas
- Pushes ImageData to segmentation queue (if enabled) or directly to ASCII queue

**Stage 2: Segmentation** (optional, monochrome mode only)
- Runs at MediaPipe throughput (~20fps on mid-range hardware)
- Pulls from segmentation queue (single-slot, drops frames if busy)
- Applies segmentation mask with temporal smoothing
- Pushes masked ImageData to ASCII queue

**Stage 3: ASCII Conversion** (in worker)
- Runs at worker throughput (~30fps with worker, potentially higher with WebGL)
- Pulls from ASCII queue (single-slot mailbox)
- Sends ImageData to worker
- Receives result and updates store

Each stage runs independently. If a stage is slow, it drops frames instead of blocking upstream stages.

Implement using three separate `requestAnimationFrame` loops (or two rAF + one worker loop).

Target: smooth 30fps even when segmentation or ASCII conversion drops frames.
tasks.testStrategy: Enable all three stages. Verify video preview stays smooth at 30fps even if ASCII output updates slower. Artificially throttle worker and verify video capture continues smoothly. Measure stage throughput independently.

tasks.title: Write deployment documentation
tasks.description: Document Vercel deployment process, environment requirements, and build configuration
tasks.details:
Update `docs/infra/deployment.md`:

```md
# Deployment

## Vercel (Production)

1. Connect repo to Vercel
2. Set build command: `pnpm run build`
3. Set output directory: `dist`
4. Deploy

No environment variables required (client-side only app).

## Build Configuration

- Framework: Vite
- Node version: 18+
- Package manager: pnpm
- Build command: `pnpm run build`
- Dev command: `pnpm run dev`

## CDN Dependencies

MediaPipe WASM is loaded from jsdelivr.net CDN at runtime. No CDN bundling required.

## Browser Requirements

- Modern browser with getUserMedia support
- WebAssembly support (for MediaPipe)
- Canvas 2D API
- Optional: OffscreenCanvas + WebGL2 (for Phase 4 performance features)
```

Update README.md with deployment link once live.
tasks.testStrategy: Follow deployment steps and verify app deploys successfully to Vercel. Verify all features work in production build. Verify MediaPipe loads from CDN.
